title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up today.

HPI
The patient presents for routine follow-up management of type 2 diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease stage 4. He reports generally feeling well since the last visit. He continues to take his long-term insulin regimen as prescribed. He denies any recent changes in his routine or new symptoms.

Medication List
Insulin, long-term.

Exam
Vitals are stable today. Physical exam is unremarkable.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen for management of type 2 diabetes mellitus. Monitor renal function and symptoms related to chronic kidney disease stage 4 at each visit. Follow up in three months.
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes in the Index, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E11.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: The provider does not have to write 'due to'; 'with' presumes the link.
E11.2 is a subcategory; a 5th character is required.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
